answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, expired if not renewed by fresh work, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Each submission hangs on the nebula of a task receipt, and the jade is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. What survives to the summit is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
